robots.name: R5-D4
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one square individual robot portrait for the Armoured Souls game. Create an original robot design with its own construction and proportions. Premium realistic industrial science-fiction 3D render, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, believable materials. Quiet charcoal-to-black studio backdrop, dark floor, faint low haze. Neutral soft key light and cool upper-right rim. Three-quarter view, entire robot, wheels, antennae and tools visible, centered at 80% canvas height with clear margin on all sides. Readable at 512px. One robot only. No text, logos, watermark, frame, interface, collage, firing, explosions or extra characters.
Subject: Original desert salvage utility robot on four large rugged wheels, each on an independent articulated suspension strut. Low rounded rectangular cream-and-ochre cargo body, copper patch plates, pale mint access doors, a short swivelling square periscope sensor mast and a folded lifting fork along the side. Dust and restrained oxidation. Friendly compact proportions, unique rolling-toolbox silhouette, all four wheels and mast fully visible.
robots.refinement_note: Tycoon follows the supplied strategy rule: no weapon refinements. This is an explicit empty plan.
robots.equipment_interpretation: R5-D4 fills the flexible line fighter role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Versatile tuning supports the short equipment role; balanced stance and a 15% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Tycoon strategy tuning rules with the Versatile Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

original_record.original_plan_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 85% of square canvas with breathing room. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.
Subject: Authentic R5-D4 Tatooine astromech: squat white cylindrical body with red panels, flat-topped trapezoidal white/red head and three front red photoreceptor details, two side legs and central support foot, dusty scratched metal. Preserve characteristic R5 head rather than R2's dome. Whole robot, no Jawas or people, no invented humanoid hands or large weapons.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #106 slot 1 R5-D4.
original_record.visual_review: Accepted — original interpretation reviewed for complete-body framing, correct mechanical anatomy, readable silhouette, matching materials and studio lighting
original_record.original_source_edition: classic Tatooine service hardware. R5-D4 has his recognizable red-and-white flat-topped astromech head; the Treadwell retains its tracked base, thin neck, and tool arms; the GNK retains its box-shaped walking-generator body. Use sand, oxidized metal, patched housings, and restrained grime. Avoid turning the tiny GNK into an unrelated humanoid mech or equipping the Treadwell with a different source model's anatomy.
original_record.source_reference_note: References describe the roster background; the final visual design is an original interpretation.
